'''Ov''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who, by circa [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], had became a member of a group of [[Believers]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], under the command of [[Alina Impeveri]].

==Personality and traits==
Despite not being a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Ov wanted to become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The Trandoshan wore [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] that had been looted from a Jedi corpse, and obtained a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Ov practiced lightsaber techniques with fellow Believer [[Squick]].
